answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in kernel and lotus lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the tundra graph. A farm of 3913 identities would post 1821 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
